original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Exact bit-lane enumeration of low-weight binary words, integrated into the complete pinned E7 classification replay.
scope_change_reason: Refine the replay-runtime card to the binary frame-code census in PR5669.
bottleneck_link: The full E7 support census is a dependency of E8 deletion and decoder certificates. Exact faster replay increases verification capacity without changing a physical bill.
stop_rule: Require complete old/new result equality, unchanged downstream checks, exhaustive small-code oracles and a measured complete-replay speed gain. Reject on any mismatch.
evidence: RESULT.json, BENCHMARK.json, PROOF.md and VALIDATION.md give exact scope, timings, checks and limits.
author: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in implementation, proof, verification and prose. No subagents. Same assistant family as the consumed classifier; no independent human review.

open_questions.question: Which larger deletion or decoder code census benefits from this exact iterator?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The present consumer is the complete E7 classification; another consumer needs its own correctness and runtime check.
open_questions.first_step: Bind one actual code basis and compare all checks and outputs before replacing its enumeration.
open_questions.blocked_by: No other consumer is installed by this package.

expansion_decision.decision: Optimize the complete existing consumer and provide a general exact code iterator. Stop before a new geometry search.
expansion_decision.proved_costs: All coefficient assignments remain covered; finite storage and Boolean arithmetic costs are explicit.
expansion_decision.unknowns: No physical supplier, native-cost change, whole-caller benefit or new kappa is inferred.

freshness.scope: No competing E7 bit-lane optimization within searched public coverage.
